limit.description: Number of UTF-8 bytes to read: integer 1 through 65536 inclusive. Use 65536 for a normal page; never request the whole file with a larger limit.

offset.description: Zero-based byte offset, 0 through 4294967295. Start at 0; page using the returned next offset.

max_active_ms.description: Positive integer within goal_budget.max_active_ms; null only when the pinned Goal budget sets no active-time ceiling.

max_provider_calls.description: Positive integer within goal_budget.max_provider_calls; null only when the pinned Goal budget sets no provider-call ceiling.

max_tokens.description: Positive integer within goal_budget.max_tokens; null only when the pinned Goal budget sets no token ceiling.

command_timeout_ms.description: Integer 1000 through 600000 inclusive, or null for the pinned default.

commands.description: Up to 8 distinct admitted command names in ascending order; each uses lowercase letters, digits, '-' or '_', at most 64 bytes.

mcp_tools.description: Up to 64 distinct admitted MCP bindings in ascending server and tool order. Server names are at most 64 bytes and tool names at most 128 bytes, each using lowercase letters, digits, '-' or '_'.

mission.description: Non-empty UTF-8 Goal mission, at most 2048 bytes.

paths.description: Up to 64 distinct Workspace-relative paths in ascending order, each at most 512 bytes. Use "." alone for the whole Workspace; nested paths are rejected.

skills.description: Up to 64 distinct admitted Skill bindings in ascending name and resource order. Names use lowercase letters, digits, '-' or '_', at most 64 bytes; resource is null for SKILL.md or a relative path of at most 512 bytes.

path.description: Workspace-relative file path, at most 512 bytes; paths must cover it.

content.description: UTF-8 text, at most 8192 bytes; the whole plan contract must serialize within 8 KiB.

path.description: Workspace-relative file path, at most 512 bytes; paths must cover it.
